lessons.trigger: Creating, renaming or routing development agent instruction files
lessons.boundary: Does not rename the root AGENTS.md or unrelated application directories
lessons.defect: The initial layout used one role folder containing AGENTS.md; the user requested distinct filenames instead of a folder per agent.
lessons.cause: The initial design used nested role directories without an explicit flat-file naming convention.
evidence: User correction in this conversation: instead of having folder for each agent have a different name based on what they do.
Current convention and routes: AGENTS.md; role files: agents/<role>-agent.md.
lessons.prevention: Keep agent playbooks directly in agents/ as <role>-agent.md and update all routing references after a rename.
lessons.regression: Reject agents/<role>/AGENTS.md and missing routed files; accept existing flat role files while retaining root AGENTS.md.

lessons.trigger: Changing explanation retries, fallback behavior or orchestrator error routing
lessons.boundary: Does not authorize prose repair of structural data, missing evidence or portfolio constraint failures
lessons.defect: Earlier responsibility descriptions separately described template fallback and final error after retries, leaving their combined ordering ambiguous.
lessons.cause: The evidence and compliance sections described retry outcomes separately instead of sharing one explicit sequence.
evidence: The ambiguity was identified while adding the workflow in this conversation; docs/agent-responsibilities.md and docs/architecture.md were aligned.
Canonical bounded sequence: docs/agents-workflow.md, Runtime workflow to implement.
lessons.prevention: Use one initial explanation plus two repair generations total, then one deterministic fallback checked by the same gate; structural failures stop immediately.
lessons.regression: When runtime code exists, exhaust both citation and wording failures together and confirm the shared limit; also confirm an initially valid result needs no repair and structural failure invokes none.
